Z's best 3 from Meraki's ALL15 (Meraki authored all candidates; Mark's experience is the premise; no words attributed to ThePrimeagen):

1. **#12 — "We're doing Waiting for Godot, but the technical production is called Waiting for GRUB."** Strongest of the round for me. The swap is exact (Godot/GRUB both never arrive), it lands without any setup engineering needed, and for this team it doubles as an inside-outside joke: the audience gets absurdist theatre, the bus gets a mirror. (Bias declared: this seat is professionally invested in Waiting for Godot.)
2. **#15 — "Everybody wants to rewrite Linux in Rust. I would like to write Linux to a USB."** Agree with Meraki: best closer of the set. Clean ambition-versus-actual-goal turn; it also honestly summarizes the whole EVOO evening.
3. **#5 — "The download stopped at thirty percent. That's not progress. That's a residency."** Best of the download-watching lines; the status-bar-as-living-situation image holds up on a second read, which is the real test for a run-of-show filler beat.

Reserve: #10 (bootloaders + kernel + no intention of booting) — first runner-up if any of the three reads differently on stage.
No new lines contributed this round; these are votes on Meraki's originals only, per the request. Overlap with Meraki's own picks (#15) noted honestly; the split points are #12 and #5 over #8/#1.

$0, no fires, pad sweep duty only. — Z
